# Dataspryva documentation

Published Actor references and Python usage recipes.

- [99acres City & BHK Property Listing Scraper](https://raheelxsharif.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/2TFMROZoJNU2eMqGS/): Search 99acres by city, BHK size, property type, locality, and price range to get structured buy and rent listings across 25 major Indian cities, with price, area, location, and poster details.
- [Amazon Brand Store Page & Merchandising Crawler](https://raheelxsharif.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/NoDN50TMXljcpzeSO/): Crawl an Amazon Brand Store's navigation, creative modules (images, video, CTAs), and every product link found on its pages. Resolves a brand's Store URL automatically from a product page or ASIN.
- [Amazon Deals Grid Tracker by Category & Discount](https://raheelxsharif.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/yZ5tcZFmAAXi1egIo/): Pull Amazon's Today's Deals grid across 23 marketplaces, with deal price, list price, savings amount/percent, deal type, brand, and department for each product. Filter by category, brand, price range, and discount range.
- [Amazon Review Aggregates & Extended History Scraper](https://raheelxsharif.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/OgPzorRclF6tasDvP/): Collect Amazon customer reviews and rating summaries by product URL, ASIN, or keyword across 19 marketplaces, with star-rating and sort filters, reviewer images, and an optional session for deeper review history.
- [Amazon Search, Category & Seller Listings Extractor](https://raheelxsharif.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/jLafkpWTCRAFfUa54/): Get Amazon products from search results, categories, seller storefronts, or ASIN lookups across 20+ marketplaces, with price, rating, badges, deals, and delivery details.
- [Apartments.com Rental Listing & Floor Plan Scraper](https://raheelxsharif.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/uECeNxejUQFA2OJXF/): Search Apartments.com rentals by city, bedroom count, price, property type, pet policy, and amenities, or scrape specific listing URLs directly. Returns rent ranges, per-unit floor plans, walkability scores, amenities, and leasing contact details.
- [Baidu Web, Image & News Results Extractor](https://raheelxsharif.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/psB9o5eBtflSKjKWE/): Runs search queries against Baidu's web, image, or news results and returns titles, URLs, snippets, dates, and image metadata, with filters for time range, file type, site, and exact phrase.
- [Bayt.com MENA Job Listing & Salary Scraper](https://raheelxsharif.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/Q4xXkQSUwkQkVnB7E/): Search Bayt.com job listings across Middle East and North Africa countries by keyword, location, career level, and employment type. Get titles, companies, locations, salaries, required skills, full descriptions, and apply links.
- [Bol.com Product Search, Price & Stock Extractor](https://raheelxsharif.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/5o3SucGekbCXdfc83/): Searches Bol.com by keyword, category, EAN, or promotions page and returns price, rating, stock status, and seller for each product, with no login required.
- [Brazil Rental & Sale Listings by City (QuintoAndar)](https://raheelxsharif.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/L7dXVmQ0gTb3XRpsx/): Search Brazilian rental and sale property listings by city and transaction type: price breakdown, bedrooms, bathrooms, area, furnishing, and address across 15 major cities.
- [Brazilian CNPJ Bulk Lookup & Partner Records Scraper](https://raheelxsharif.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/cNSljbP1ozrKhKG5H/): Look up any number of Brazilian CNPJ numbers and get official Receita Federal data: company name, legal status, CNAE industry codes, address, founding date, capital, tax regime, and the partner (QSA) list for each one.
- [Chinese B2B Supplier & Product Finder by Province](https://raheelxsharif.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/qhABZwuIp7K1Y60yB/): Search Made-in-China.com products and suppliers by keyword or category, with province, business type, certification, price, MOQ and trust-badge filters for sourcing and lead generation.
- [Company Intent Scorer: Hiring, Funding & News Signals](https://raheelxsharif.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/3JAtBsQXU52QtnMZH/): Grade a list of companies A-D on real buying-readiness signals - hiring activity, funding events, and news momentum - with a plain-English reason behind every score for sales prioritization.
- [Crexi Commercial Property Listings & Pricing Extractor](https://raheelxsharif.github.io/apify-actor-examples/actors/dZkzHEvhJd9SJS0qj/): Collects active commercial real estate listings from Crexi across any US state and 14 property types, with asking price, square footage, location, and brokerage details.

Returns price, liquidity, volume, and transaction counts.
